title: DevOps Engineer Learning Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step guide to move from zero to job‑ready DevOps Engineer. It builds Linux fundamentals, core automation tools, portfolio projects, and job‑search readiness.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Lay the essential groundwork in operating systems, version control, and scripting.

milestones.title: Linux Basics
milestones.outcome: You can navigate the command line, manage files, and use common shell tools.

tasks.title: Read Linux command line tutorial
tasks.description: Study the introductory sections of the Linux Documentation Project or freeCodeCamp’s Linux Basics guide.

tasks.title: Practice basic commands
tasks.description: Open a terminal (or WSL) and execute ls, cd, cp, mv, mkdir, and rm on sample directories.

tasks.title: Create a shell script
tasks.description: Write a script that backs up a folder to a timestamped zip file and run it.

tasks.title: Reflect on permissions
tasks.description: Write a short note on how file permissions work and why they matter in DevOps.

milestones.title: Git Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: You can initialize repositories, commit changes, branch, merge, and resolve simple conflicts.

tasks.title: Complete Git basics module
tasks.description: Follow the freeCodeCamp Git & GitHub certification lessons.

tasks.title: Initialize a repo and commit
tasks.description: Create a new folder, init Git, add files, and make several commits.

tasks.title: Branch and merge exercise
tasks.description: Create a feature branch, modify a file, merge back, and resolve any conflicts.

tasks.title: Push to GitHub
tasks.description: Create a GitHub account, push the local repo, and verify the remote history.

milestones.title: Scripting Foundations
milestones.outcome: You can write simple Bash scripts to automate repetitive tasks.

tasks.title: Watch Bash scripting video
tasks.description: Watch the Bash scripting playlist on YouTube (e.g., “Bash Scripting Basics”).

tasks.title: Write a loop script
tasks.description: Create a script that iterates over files in a directory and logs their sizes.

tasks.title: Test script with edge cases
tasks.description: Run the script with empty directories and permission‑restricted files.

tasks.title: Document script usage
tasks.description: Add comments and a usage help message to the script.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Master containerization, orchestration, and infrastructure automation tools.

milestones.title: Docker Essentials
milestones.outcome: You can build, run, and share container images for applications.

tasks.title: Read Docker overview on Docker Docs
tasks.description: Study the Getting Started guide on docker.com to understand images and containers.

tasks.title: Install Docker locally
tasks.description: Set up Docker Desktop (or Docker Engine) on your machine and verify with docker version.

tasks.title: Build a simple image
tasks.description: Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js hello‑world app and build the image.

tasks.title: Run container with ports
tasks.description: Start the container, map port 3000, and access the app in a browser.

tasks.title: Push image to Docker Hub
tasks.description: Create a Docker Hub account and push your image, then pull it on another machine.

milestones.title: Kubernetes Intro
milestones.outcome: You can deploy a containerized app to a local Kubernetes cluster.

tasks.title: Study Kubernetes concepts on Kubernetes Docs
tasks.description: Read the “What is Kubernetes?” and basic architecture sections on kubernetes.io.

tasks.title: Install Kind or Minikube
tasks.description: Set up a local single‑node cluster using Kind or Minikube and verify with kubectl version.

tasks.title: Deploy a sample app
tasks.description: Apply a provided deployment and service YAML for nginx and check pod status.

tasks.title: Expose service via NodePort
tasks.description: Modify the service to use NodePort and access it from localhost.

tasks.title: Scale the deployment
tasks.description: Use kubectl scale to increase replicas and observe load balancing.

milestones.title: Infrastructure as Code
milestones.outcome: You can define cloud resources using Terraform and apply them safely.

tasks.title: Read Terraform getting started guide
tasks.description: Follow the official Terraform tutorial on terraform.io for AWS or GCP.

tasks.title: Install Terraform CLI
tasks.description: Download the binary, add it to PATH, and run terraform version.

tasks.title: Write a VPC module
tasks.description: Create a Terraform file that provisions a simple VPC with a subnet.

tasks.title: Run terraform init & apply
tasks.description: Initialize the working directory and apply the configuration in a sandbox account.

tasks.title: Destroy resources safely
tasks.description: Execute terraform destroy and verify all resources are removed.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Create portfolio projects that showcase end‑to‑end DevOps pipelines.

milestones.title: CI/CD Pipeline for Web App
milestones.outcome: You can automate build, test, and deployment of a sample web application.

tasks.title: Design pipeline diagram
tasks.description: Sketch the stages (checkout, build, test, deploy) on paper or a digital tool.

tasks.title: Set up GitHub Actions workflow
tasks.description: Create a .github/workflows yaml that builds a Docker image and pushes it to Docker Hub.

tasks.title: Add unit tests step
tasks.description: Integrate a simple test command (e.g., npm test) into the workflow and ensure it fails on broken code.

tasks.title: Deploy to Kind cluster
tasks.description: Extend the workflow to apply the new image to a local Kind cluster using kubectl.

tasks.title: Document project on GitHub
tasks.description: Write a README that explains the pipeline, how to run it, and screenshots of results.

milestones.title: Containerised Multi‑Service App
milestones.outcome: You can orchestrate multiple containers with Docker Compose and Kubernetes.

tasks.title: Choose sample microservices
tasks.description: Select two simple services (e.g., Flask API and Redis) from GitHub examples.

tasks.title: Write Dockerfiles for each
tasks.description: Create minimal Dockerfiles, build images locally, and tag them.

tasks.title: Compose with Docker Compose
tasks.description: Define a docker‑compose.yml that links the services and runs them together.

tasks.title: Translate to Kubernetes manifests
tasks.description: Convert the compose setup into Deployment and Service YAMLs for K8s.

tasks.title: Test failover scenario
tasks.description: Kill one pod and observe Kubernetes self‑healing, noting logs.

milestones.title: Terraform Infrastructure Project
milestones.outcome: You can provision cloud infrastructure and expose it to the container apps.

tasks.title: Select cloud provider free tier
tasks.description: Create a free‑tier account on AWS or GCP for experimentation.

tasks.title: Write Terraform for VPC and EKS
tasks.description: Define resources for networking and a managed Kubernetes cluster.

tasks.title: Apply and verify cluster
tasks.description: Run terraform apply, then use kubectl to list nodes in the new cluster.

tasks.title: Deploy earlier app to cloud
tasks.description: Push the container images to a registry and deploy them on the provisioned cluster.

tasks.title: Clean up resources
tasks.description: Execute terraform destroy and confirm no lingering charges.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Polish advanced topics, professional presence, and job‑search strategy.

milestones.title: Advanced Monitoring
milestones.outcome: You can set up observability stacks and interpret key metrics.

tasks.title: Read Prometheus & Grafana basics
tasks.description: Study the official Prometheus and Grafana getting started guides.

tasks.title: Install Prometheus on Kind
tasks.description: Deploy the Prometheus Operator via Helm chart to your local cluster.

tasks.title: Create a Grafana dashboard
tasks.description: Add panels for CPU, memory, and pod restarts of your sample app.

tasks.title: Set up alert rule
tasks.description: Configure an alert for pod crash loops and test it by killing a pod.

tasks.title: Write monitoring summary
tasks.description: Summarize what metrics you chose and why in a short doc.

milestones.title: Security & Best Practices
milestones.outcome: You can apply hardening and compliance checks to pipelines and clusters.

tasks.title: Study OWASP DevSecOps checklist
tasks.description: Read the free OWASP DevSecOps guide for common security controls.

tasks.title: Add Trivy scan to pipeline
tasks.description: Integrate a Trivy image scan step into your GitHub Actions workflow.

tasks.title: Enable Kubernetes pod security policies
tasks.description: Create a PSP that restricts privileged containers and apply it.

tasks.title: Review Git commit hygiene
tasks.description: Enforce conventional commits in your repo and rewrite any bad history.

tasks.title: Document security measures
tasks.description: Add a Security section to your project READMEs describing the steps taken.

milestones.title: Job‑Ready Portfolio & Networking
milestones.outcome: You can present your work confidently and connect with hiring teams.

tasks.title: Create personal website
tasks.description: Use GitHub Pages to host a simple site that showcases your projects and skills.

tasks.title: Write concise project case studies
tasks.description: For each portfolio project, draft a 150‑word summary highlighting challenges and results.

tasks.title: Update LinkedIn with DevOps focus
tasks.description: Add the new skills, certifications, and link to your GitHub portfolio.

tasks.title: Attend a free DevOps meetup
tasks.description: Join a virtual meetup or local user group and introduce yourself.

tasks.title: Prepare interview stories
tasks.description: Write STAR‑format answers for common DevOps scenarios (e.g., incident response).
